edges.justification: A cloudy sky is a precursor to rainfall; cloud formation precedes rain, so cloudiness causes rain.
When it is cloudy, people tend to turn off or avoid turning on sprinklers to prevent unnecessary watering, so cloudiness influences the sprinkler state.
Rain directly wets the grass on the same day, so rainfall causes wet grass.
Water from the sprinkler moistens the grass during the same day, making the sprinkler a direct cause of wet grass.
